positions.title: Broadcast Transmission Engineer
positions.description: Prioritize tasks as they come in;  Approve and maintain department budget;  Maintain high/low power, large/small signals, and varied engineering tasks to ensure proper station operation;  Maintain and repair critical infrastructure and facilities;  Maintain and repair HVAC;  Complete special projects;  Install and integrate new studio equipment;   Design and install critical system remote failure system bypass;  Design remote system for switching transmitter termination.

positions.title: Co-Op Engineer
positions.description: Maintain high/low power, large/small signals, and varied engineering tasks to ensure proper station operation;   Complete special projects;  Design amp for building stereo system;  Install and integrate new studio equipment;   Design multi-station warning system;  Design remote system for switching transmitter termination.

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description: Performed design, research, and experiments related to PCB (Printed Circuit Board) noise reduction.  The Goal was to create a methodology explaining good design methods for minimizing noise.  LARSS (Langley Aerospace Research Summer Scholars) Program.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington

volunteerExperiences.description: Assist people with all types of disabilities in therapeutic horse back riding.
